items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Gillespie and — [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah, yeah. And they would go in to the store...

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. And they would go in to the store and his mother would just put the pots on and everybody would eat. Well we’d play. And we’d stay over there and we’d play and everything. And then we, the group came, kind of worked together a lot and then we made a record. I think what happened is Nat Adderley I think heard about us. And Cannon had a series called “Cannonball Adderley Presents” at that time, from Riverside Records. And he signed us for Riverside and we did our first album.
